title: SpinOut Scenic Waterbike Experience of San Francisco Bay
includes: 1 x Custom Waterbike (Fits most riders 5'0'' - 6'2'' Max Weight 250lbs)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Meet Damien, he is the founder of SpinOut Fitness. He loves the water​ and has always gravitated​ toward its healing energy, awesome beauty and power. 

Coming from an adventurous, worldly, loyal, hardworking family of High ranking millitary offeicers, commercial fisherman, award-winning racing yachtsman, and career nurses. Damien is ready for just about anything!

He is also well certified: as a personal train​er, group fitness instructor, swimmer, lifeguard​​, yoga instructor, awarded boy-scout, creative photographer and inventive entrepreneur. 

He is always committed to keep Waterbiking his full time profession even through this pandemic. Details are important; studying​ of water patterns, planning ahead, to choosing the best equipment has allowed him to safely and passionately lead over 3000 experiences over the past 4 years. He does it so you can have the ride of your life!

Every single day is different, it never gets old and there is alway new and fun things to discover.
